noi_dung:
PURPOSE: WHY SINCERELY REPENT AND PRAY FOR DECEASED AND ABORTED INFANTS?

In modern society, many parents have undergone abortions or lost infants through premature miscarriage. In the spiritual perspective of Buddhism, human life begins at the precise moment of conception when consciousness enters the womb. An aborted infant loses the precious opportunity to obtain a human rebirth and often wanders in deep confusion, cold, and resentment.

Because of their vulnerability and attachment to their mother, these infant spirits often stay close to their parents. Without understanding the Dharma, their feelings of rejection and abandonment can manifest as family friction, psychological anguish, or health complications.

By holding sincere repentance rituals, giving the infant spirit a Dharma name, offering sincere apologies with tears of remorse, and transferring meritorious deeds to them, parents can help heal the spiritual wound. Relying on Kṣitigarbha Bodhisattva and Amitābha Buddha, these infant souls are guided directly to the Pure Land.

tieu_de: Liturgy of Sincere Repentance for Aborted Infants
noi_dung:
THE LITURGY OF SINCERE REPENTANCE AND DELIVERANCE FOR DECEASED AND ABORTED INFANTS

(All recite in unison):
Bowing our heads to the Tathāgata,
Unequaled throughout the Ten Dharma Realms.
The Dharmakāya ever abides eternally,
His limitless transformation bodies deliver living beings.

HOMAGE TO THE BUDDHAS AND BODHISATTVAS

Namo Fundamental Teacher Śākyamuni Buddha! (3 bows)
Namo Guide of the Western Paradise Amitābha Buddha! (1 bow)
Namo Great Vow Kṣitigarbha Bodhisattva! (3 bows)
Namo Great Compassion Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva! (1 bow)
Namo Ever-Abiding Triple Gem of the Ten Directions! (1 bow)

HEARTFELT SINCERE REPENTANCE BEFORE THE INFANT SPIRIT

"Dear child: Due to our ignorance, selfishness, and difficult circumstances in the past, your father and mother committed the gravest wrong of depriving you of your chance to be born into this world. We know that you suffered immense terror, pain, and abandonment, and for this, we feel unbearable heartbreak and remorse.
Today, before the Buddhas and the Great Vow Kṣitigarbha Bodhisattva, we prostrate with all our heart to beg for your forgiveness. We bestow upon you the Dharma name [Dharma Name].
May you not harbor resentment or pain toward us any longer. Take the hand of Kṣitigarbha Bodhisattva and Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva, step upon the radiant golden lotus, and follow Amitābha Buddha to the Western Pure Land of Ultimate Bliss, where only eternal peace, joy, and beauty exist."

Namo Great Vow Kṣitigarbha Bodhisattva. (108 times)
Namo Amitābha Buddha. (108 times)

Pure Land Rebirth Dhāraṇī:
Namo amitābhāya tathāgatāya tadyathā: amṛtodbhave amṛtasaṃbhave amṛtavikrānte amṛtavikrāntagāmini gagana kīrtikare svāhā. (3 times)

THE THREE REFUGES & DEDICATION

I take refuge in the Buddha, Dharma, and Sangha.
May all merit from this ceremony be dedicated to our child.
May you leave all pain behind and be peacefully reborn in the Land of Ultimate Bliss.
